shell_commands: find . -name "*.test.ts" -type f | head -3 | xargs wc -l | tail -1

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): acceptance tests for onError with non-Error rejections

Add four acceptance tests verifying that onError is called for every rejection:
- String rejections wrapped in Error with cause preserved
- Plain object rejections wrapped in Error with cause preserved
- Undefined rejections wrapped in Error
- Error instances passed through unchanged

Tests currently fail because the catch block gates onError on
error instanceof Error, bypassing the hook for non-Error rejections.
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD && echo "Branch is up to date with main" || echo "Branch needs merge with main"
